RHI — Rendering Hardware Interface

Stable Engine Last verified: 2026-11-18 Source: rhi/RenderDevice.hpp

The RHI wraps SDL3 GPU: one device, explicit command buffers, textures, buffers, shaders, samplers, graphics pipelines and compute pipelines. The engine does not call SDL_GPU directly outside this layer.

Why it exists. Render code targets one API. Today it is SDL3 GPU (Vulkan, D3D12 or Metal underneath); a future backend can be swapped without rewriting the renderer.

Frame lifecycle#

cpp
Caffeine::RHI::RenderDevice device;
device.init(window, {.width = 1600, .height = 900, .vsync = true});

Caffeine::RHI::CommandBuffer* cmd = device.beginFrame();
Caffeine::RHI::RenderPassDesc pass{};
pass.colorTarget = nullptr;   // nullptr = swapchain
cmd->beginRenderPass(pass);
cmd->bindPipeline(pipeline);
cmd->bindVertexBuffer(vertices);
cmd->draw(3);
cmd->endRenderPass();
device.endFrame(cmd);

beginFrame acquires the swapchain image and returns a command buffer for the frame. endFrame submits it. Up to three frames are in flight (MAX_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT).

Offscreen rendering#

For thumbnails, material previews, the Doppio viewport and tests:

cpp
CommandBuffer* cmd = device.beginOffscreen();
// record into a texture, then submit without waiting
device.endOffscreen(cmd);
// later: copy the texture and call device.releaseOffscreenResources()

readTexture(texture, pixels) reads mip 0 of a 4-byte-per-pixel colour texture and blocks. beginOffscreen has no swapchain, so it works without a window when the device was created with initOffscreen.

Resources#

ResourceCreateDestroy
TexturecreateTexture(TextureDesc)destroyTexture
BuffercreateBuffer(BufferDesc, BufferUsage)destroyBuffer
ShadercreateShader(ShaderDesc)destroyShader
Graphics pipelinecreateGraphicsPipeline(vs, fs, desc)destroyPipeline
Compute pipelinecreateComputePipeline(desc)destroyComputePipeline
SamplercreateSampler(SamplerDesc)destroySampler

Uploads: uploadBuffer, uploadTexture, uploadTexture3D. Shader bytecode can be SPIR-V, DXBC, MSL or a metallib; ShaderBytecodeFormat selects it.

Command buffer#

Group Methods
Render pass beginRenderPass, endRenderPass
Binding bindPipeline, bindVertexBuffer, bindIndexBuffer, bindTexture, bindVertexTexture, setViewport, setScissor
Draw draw, drawIndexed, drawInstanced, drawIndexedInstanced
Uniforms pushUniformData(stage, slot, data, size)
Compute beginComputePass, bindComputePipeline, bindComputeStorageBuffers, bindComputeTextures, pushComputeUniformData, dispatch, endComputePass
Copies copyTexture, copyTextureRegion, generateMipmaps

A command buffer records one pass at a time. Check isInRenderPass() / isInComputePass() when a helper may be called from both paths.

Formats and usage#

TextureFormat maps SDL formats and adds the formats the renderer needs (R8G8_UNORM for the Photon G-buffer, R16G16_FLOAT for probe moments, R11G11B10_UFLOAT for HDR probes). TextureUsage is a bit mask: Sampler | ColorTarget | DepthStencil | StorageRead | ComputeRead | ComputeWrite.

GraphicsPipelineDesc accepts up to four colour targets (kMaxColorTargets), vertex layouts with VertexFormat::Float2/3/4, blend modes (Alpha, Premultiplied, Additive, Min) and a fill mode (Fill or Line).

Textures and the editor#

The Doppio viewport renders through the engine RHI offscreen, then reads the texture back to the Rust process. SDL_GPU does not expose a native texture handle through the public API, so the editor cannot share the texture directly; see Scene viewport.

Design rules#

  1. One owner per resource. Create and destroy through RenderDevice.
  2. No hidden state. Bind everything a draw needs; pipelines do not remember textures.
  3. Offscreen paths use beginOffscreen. Never open a window for a thumbnail or a test.
  4. Uploads are staged. uploadTexture handles the transfer buffer; do not map SDL buffers outside the RHI.
  5. Retired textures are deferred. The device keeps them alive for frames in flight before releasing them.

Tests#

tests/test_rhi.cpp covers device init, offscreen passes, texture creation, uploads, pipelines and readback. Run it with:

bash
./build/tests/CaffeineTest "[rhi]"
